learning_objective: 🎯 Learn to dribble like a pro, pass with pinpoint precision, and score epic goals on the football field with your team!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Dribbling is the art of running while keeping the football practically glued to your feet! Use quick, gentle taps with the inside and outside of your boots to glide past defenders.
Football is a team sport, and passing is how you share the magic. Always look up to spot your teammates, and use the wide inside part of your foot for an accurate, flat pass.
When it is time to score, lock your ankle and strike the center of the ball with the hard instep (the laces) of your shoe. Lean over the ball slightly to keep your shot powerful and low!

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The Digroz Dribble Dash
fun_activity.instructions: Set up three empty water bottles in a line in your yard. Practice weaving your football cleanly through them in a zig-zag pattern without knocking any bottles over!

quick_recap: ⭐ Keep the ball close to your body while dribbling so opponents cannot steal it.
⭐ Accurate passing builds teamwork and creates open spaces to attack.
⭐ Strike with your laces and lean forward for the most powerful shot on goal.
